content_sections.heading: CUH Recruitment 2026 - Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: A total of 14 vacancies are available - 1 for Associate Professor (Sanskrit), 2 for Associate Professor (Civil Engineering), 3 for Assistant Professor (Civil Engineering), 1 for Assistant Professor (Specialization in Mechanical Engineering - Civil), 2 for Associate Professor (Electrical Engineering), 3 for Assistant Professor (Electrical Engineering), 1 for Assistant Professor (Specialization in Mechanical Engineering - Electrical) and 1 for Associate Professor (Library & Information Science).

faq.question: Q1. What are the total vacancies in CUH Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Central University of Haryana (CUH) has announced a total of 14 vacancies for the posts of Associate Professor and Assistant Professor in various departments. This is a great opportunity for eligible candidates.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for CUH Associate Professor and Assistant Professor posts?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application form for the CUH Associate Professor and Assistant Professor recruitment is 30 September 2026. Candidates are advised to apply well before the deadline to avoid last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for CUH Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application mode for the Central University of Haryana (CUH) recruitment for Associate Professor and Assistant Professor posts is entirely online. Interested candidates must apply through the official website.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for Associate Professor and Assistant Professor in CUH?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for Associate Professor will receive salary at Level-13A, while Assistant Professors will be paid at Level-10. These are as per the UGC regulations and government norms.

faq.question: Q5. What is the selection process for CUH Faculty Recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process for CUH Associate Professor and Assistant Professor posts includes shortlisting based on UGC guidelines, followed by an interview, and finally, document verification. Candidates must perform well in each stage.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for CUH Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application fee for General/OBC candidates is Rs 1000/-. However, SC/ST and Women candidates are exempted from paying any application fee. This makes it accessible for many applicants.

faq.question: Q7. Where is the job location for CUH posts?
faq.answer: The job location for the Associate Professor and Assistant Professor posts at Central University of Haryana (CUH) will be in Mahendergarh, Haryana. This offers a chance to work in a central university setting.

faq.question: Q8. What are the minimum qualifications required?
faq.answer: Candidates must meet the minimum qualifications as per UGC Regulations on Minimum Qualifications for Appointment of Teachers and other Academic Staff in Universities and Colleges, 2018, and AICTE norms where applicable for engineering disciplines.

faq.question: Q9. How can I apply for CUH Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: You can apply online through the official website of Central University of Haryana (CUH). Ensure you fill out the application form accurately, upload all necessary documents, and pay the fee before the last date.

faq.question: Q10. What is the official website of Central University of Haryana?
faq.answer: The official website for Central University of Haryana (CUH) is www.cuh.ac.in. All official notifications, application forms, and updates regarding the recruitment will be available on this portal.
